compensating.why: hop 2 hands a copy of the char buffer on, so that no content of earlier writes is shared
hop 3 clears the char buffer before passing it on
hop 4 flushes the generator before the text is passed on

ownership_reason: Only the gold copies text longer than the char buffer and decides when the gathered chars are passed to the generator; hops 2-4 pass the generator, the text and the buffer along unchanged and hop 1 only writes text that fits in the buffer. The gold's javadoc promises that the text is written as raw content through the buffer, which a throw on ordinary 10000-char text is not. No non-gold hop sees the fill position or the block boundaries, so no one-line change above the gold restores the reset without disabling the gold's buffering (recorded bypasses: hop 1 writing long text with the segmented overload; a fresh text-sized array in place of the generator's char buffer, which every hop documents; a pre-split into buffer-sized substrings, which splits surrogate pairs). The convention is pinned outside the gold: UTF8JsonGenerator.writeRaw(String, int, int), the segmented sibling overload, copies each segment into the char buffer at index 0; WriterBasedJsonGenerator.writeRawLong places each piece at index 0 of its buffer after each flush (_outputHead = 0; _outputTail = amount); UTF8JsonGenerator._flushBuffer resets _outputTail to 0 when it passes its buffer on. Passing tests: RawValueWithSurrogatesTest testRawWithSurrogatesString (long raw text with surrogate pairs through the segmented sibling), StringGenerationTest testLongerRandomMultiChunk, TestUtf8Generator testSurrogatesWithRaw and TestJsonGeneratorFeatures testBigDecimalAsPlainString (through the facade).
